title: A2UI Action Card Schema
description: Agent-to-UI Action Card specification for interactive notifications, approvals, and autonomous task triage in NFP

card_id.description: Unique identifier for the action card (e.g. card-0a1b2c3d4e5f)

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of card issuance

source_agent.description: Issuing agent daemon (e.g. jev-classifier, pi-durable, hermes, antigravity)

target_persona.description: Voice/UI persona intended to present the card (e.g. jarvis-classic, glados-auditor)

title.description: Short headline for desktop notification / card banner

summary.description: Clear 1-3 sentence explanation of the situation and recommendation

risk_level.description: Severity assessment of the associated operation

actionability.description: Whether user action or confirmation is recommended

diff_preview.description: Optional file diff preview for code or configuration modifications

actions.description: Interactive action buttons rendered on the card

id.description: Unique action identifier within this card

label.description: Button label displayed to the user

payload.description: Parameters delivered to the agent upon button activation

ttl_rule.description: Fallback timeout behavior if the user does not interact with the card

timeout_seconds.description: Time to live before fallback execution
